risks.title: Natural Gas Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to volatility in gas prices, including sudden and sustained changes in natural gas prices, which can impact margin deposits and competitive position versus alternative heating sources such as electricity

risks.title: Regulatory and Legislative Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to extensive regulatory oversight affecting allowed rates of return, cost recovery, rate design, capital structure, environmental standards, pipeline safety and climate-related mandates

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT Systems Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks from disruption, failure or malfunction of operational and information technology systems due to cyberattacks, which is explicitly highlighted in forward-looking statements

risks.title: Gas Supply and Pipeline Availability Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in gas supply availability, pipeline access, and decisions by natural gas producers regarding production levels directly impact the company's ability to serve markets and maintain pricing competitiveness

risks.title: Environmental and Pipeline Safety Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates pipeline infrastructure and is exposed to environmental risks, safety incidents, and increasingly stringent climate-related regulations that could impact operations and liability

risks.title: Capital Access and Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on access to capital markets and operating cash flow to meet debt obligations and fund capital expenditures. Restrictions on capital access or deteriorating cash flow pose material risks

risks.title: Customer Retention and Revenue Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to customer retention, attraction and conservation efforts. Competition from alternative energy sources and customer conservation behavior can impact revenues

risks.title: Workforce and Labor Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to labor disputes, employee retention, attraction of key talent and rising wage and benefit costs including pension obligations
